deck_title: Scheimpflug-Merklinger tilted focal plane sharpness vs naive frontoparallel defocus rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Theodor Scheimpflug (1904) plane-intersection principle & Harold M. Merklinger (1992) hinge rule (tan(theta_lens) = (f / J) * tan(psi), tilting the lens plane so the subject plane, lens plane, and sensor plane intersect along a single common Scheimpflug line and locking PSF spot radius ratio at R_PSF = 1.0000x across all 17 oblique subject-plane stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 blurred stations) versus naive frontoparallel lens-sensor alignment (theta_lens = 0, which leaves the focal plane parallel to the sensor so Circle-of-Confusion spot radius grows as 1 + u to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-ray thin-lens bundle tracing.
